newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah lower on ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah lower on ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was lower against the dollar in early trading on Thursday, dealers said.
They said spot rupiah adjusted lower against the dollar following a longer maturity of the spot rate due to a public holiday in New York on Monday.
One local bank dealer said ample rupiah supply also helped the dollar to rebound in moderate early trading.
Spot rupiah was at 2,332.20/32.70 at 0145 GMT.
Dealers said operators were a little surprised at the ample money market despite Thursday being the last day of the Bank Negara Indonesia share offering.
Overnight swap was at 0.25 points and tom/next at 1.5.
The local bank dealer said swap rates remained soft following sustained ample rupiah supply in the money market.
One-month swap was at 15.0/16.0 and two at 32.5/33.0, three at 50.5/52.0 and six at 96.0/97.5 points.
The central bank raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,331/2,523 and the conversion rate to 2,331/2,379.
